claims.text: Alt IV: clindamycin 900 mg IV q8h + gentamicin 2 mg/kg load, then 1.5 mg/kg q8h (or 3–5 mg/kg once daily)
claims.quote: Clindamycin 900 mg IV every 8 hours plus Gentamicin loading dose IV or IM (2 mg/kg body weight), followed by a maintenance dose (1.5 mg/kg body weight) every 8 hours; single daily dosing (3–5 mg/kg body weight) can be substituted
claims.locator: Workowski KA, et al. Sexually Transmitted Infections Treatment Guidelines, 2021. MMWR Recomm Rep. 2021;70(4):1-187 (PMC8344968)
